1873 epakouo {ep-ak-oo'-o}

源自 1909 與 191; TDNT - 1:222,34; 動詞

欽定本 - hear 1; 1

1) 側耳傾聽, 專心的聽 (#林後 6:2|)
2) 聽從
record.edic_text:
1873 epakouo {ep-ak-oo'-o}

from 1909 and 191; TDNT - 1:222,34; v

AV - hear 1; 1

1) to give ear to, listen to
   1a) to perceive by the ear
2) to listen to
   2a) to hear with favour, grant one's request

same.cexp: 聽見；留意；了解；恢復聽覺；聽從
拒絕聽；不理會或無意中聽到
聽從；回應，接受；應敲門聲出來開（門）
